# Policy State Is Reproducible As Known At Any Past Date

## Requirement

**Fictitious, for illustration.** For every policy, the system shall reproduce its state as valid on any date V as it was known on any date T (T ≥ V or T < V), for at least seven years.

## Rationale

Backdated premium corrections are frequent; regulators may ask how an invoice was computed at the time.

## Acceptance Criteria

- A query "policy P, valid on V, as known at T" returns the recorded values.
- Correcting a past value does not change the result of queries with T before the correction.
